assumptions: OFF (Open Food Facts) API or embedded JSON catalog provides extended nutrient data; fields default to NULL if unavailable
Single-user local app; Room database as primary persistence layer
All UI via Jetpack Compose; Material 3 library available in dependencies
GestureScope or gesture detection infrastructure available for swipe handling
Existing MealLoggingViewModel and related flows are reusable for edit/add operations
Italian localization strings (strings-it.xml) follow existing naming convention
Linear nutrient scaling: portion effect is proportional (no non-linear bioavailability effects)
Single-threaded execution; no race conditions expected from concurrent meal edits during refresh
Nutrient enrichment migration remains additive only; new nutrient columns are nullable to preserve backward compatibility
Save/update nutrient computations continue to use existing quantity conversion factors (g/ml -> quantity/100, serving -> quantity) for all 12 nutrients
